dialog.profileLabel: Introduce yourself in a few sentences
dialog.profilePlaceholder: Example: You can call me Alex. I work at a small shop, where I use Excel to record daily sales and stock. I can make simple spreadsheets, but I have never had formal training in data analysis. I want to learn how to spot which products sell well and create a monthly report my coworkers can easily understand. Right now, I struggle to know which numbers to look at first and which chart to choose. I would like my AI teacher to explain the goal in simple language, guide me step by step using sales records for drinks and bread, finish with a checklist, and point out common mistakes such as missing returns or mixing up the number of items sold with sales revenue.
